text.p: Mosinee Paper Corp, which reported its 1996 nine months earnings surpassed all of its profits for the 1995 year, said Tuesday it backs analysts' estimates for full year 1996 earnings of $2.55 a share.
"We are comfortable with estimates" of $2.55 provided by Zacks Investment Research, Gary Peterson, Mosinee Paper vice president-finance, said in a telephone interview.
Mosinee Paper reported 1996 nine months earnings rose to $1.96 a share from $0.96 a share in the same period of 1995.
For all of 1995, Mosinee Paper reported earnings of $1.44 a share adjusted for a May 15, 1996 four-for-three stock split.

Mosinee Paper, which produces technical specialty papers, said its nine months results benefited from improved margins and its Bay West towel and tissue products products have gained additional market share.
